title: IBM watsonx Orchestrate Cartridge for Cloud Pak for Data 4.8.4 through 4.8.5, and 5.0.0 through 5.4.2 could disclose…
description: IBM watsonx Orchestrate Cartridge for Cloud Pak for Data versions 4.8.4 through 4.8.5, and 5.0.0 through 5.4.2 contains a vulnerability that could lead to disclosure of sensitive source code information. The vulnerability has a low severity score and does not impact integrity or availability. No public exploits or known active exploitation have been reported.
